title: Biofunctionalization of Magnetic Nanomaterials
protocol: Cut aluminum discs into small pieces using a single edge blade and hammer on a cutting mat.
Transfer the cut Al pieces to a 2 mL tube using tweezers.
Fill the 2 mL tube with 1 mL of 1 M sodium hydroxide (NaOH).
Leave the solution working for 30 min at room temperature inside of a chemical fume hood.
Remove only the Al pieces from the NaOH solution using tweezers and leave the NWs in the NaOH solution for an additional 30 min without changing the solution.
Place the tube containing NWs on a magnetic rack to collect NWs by removing old NaOH solution after waiting 2 min.
Replace the removed NaOH solution with fresh NaOH solution.
Sonicate the 2 mL tube containing the NWs for 30 s.
Leave the 2 mL tube inside a chemical fume hood for 1 h.
Place the 2 mL tube in the magnetic rack and wait for 2 min.
Discard the NaOH solution from the 2 mL tube.
Replace with 1 mL of absolute ethanol.
Sonicate the 2 mL tube containing ethanol for 30 s.
Place the 2 mL tube in the magnetic rack and wait 2 min.
Discard the old ethanol solution.
Replace with 1 mL of fresh absolute ethanol.
Sonicate the 2 mL tube containing ethanol for 30 s.
Repeat steps involving sonication, washing, and waiting for at least four times.
Keep the NWs in 1 mL of absolute ethanol at room temperature until needed.
Measure the concentration of iron and hence the NWs by using ICP-MS.
Transfer the NWs from step 1.14 to a 5 mL glass tube using a 1 mL pipette.
Wash an empty 2 mL tube twice with 1 mL of absolute ethanol and transfer to a 5 mL glass tube.
Add 100 μL of APTES to the NW solution in the 5 mL glass tube.
Vortex the 5 mL glass tube for 10 seconds.
Place half of the 5 mL glass tube into an ultrasonic bath containing water and sonicate for 1 hour.
After sonication, add 400 μL of deionized (DI) water followed by 20 μL of 1 M NaOH to the solution.
Sonicate the mixture for another 1 hour in the ultrasonic bath.
Place a magnet next to the glass tube for 5 minutes to collect NWs.
Replace the supernatant with 1 mL of fresh absolute ethanol and sonicate for 10 seconds.
Repeat steps 2.10-2.11 four times.
Transfer all NWs suspended in ethanol to a new 5 mL glass tube using a 1 mL pipette.
Store APTES-coated NWs in the glass tube with ethanol until needed.
Dissolve 0.4 mg of EDC and 1.1 mg of Sulfo-NHS in 1 mL MES buffer (pH 4.7).
Add 30 μL anti-CD44 antibody, 960 μL PBS (pH 7), and 10 μL EDC/sulfo-NHS mixture to a new 2 mL tube.
Place the tube in a tube shaker at 10 x g for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash APTES coated nanowires by placing a magnet next to the tube for 2 min, discarding ethanol, and replacing with 1 mL PBS (pH 7).
Sonicate for 10 s and repeat washing steps four times.
Collect nanowires using a magnet and discard supernatant.
Transfer activated antibody solution to nanowire tube.
Sonicate for 10 s and incubate overnight at 4 °C in a rotator.
Collect nanowires using a magnet and discard the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of 2% BSA solution for blocking reaction at 4 °C for 1 h.
Check the antigenicity of the antibody-functionalized NWs using immunoprecipitation and western blot assays.
Seed nine wells in a 96-well plate with 4 x 10^4 HCT116 cells suspended in McCoy’s cell culture media (100 µL/well) and incubate overnight at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Wash the NWs three times with PBS by collecting them using a magnet, replacing the old solution with 1 mL of 0.01 M PBS (pH 7).
Wash the NWs three times with warmed McCoy’s media by collecting them using a magnet, replacing the old PBS with 1 mL of warmed McCoy’s media.
Replace the 1 mL of warmed McCoy’s media with 900 µL of warmed McCoy’s media.
Take the 96-well plate from the incubator to the biosafety cabinet.
Discard the old media from the cells.
Replace with 100 µL of suspended NWs.
Shake the plate by hand.
Incubate it for 24 h inside the incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Take out the 96-well plate from the incubator the next day.
Add 11 µL of cell viability reagent to each well using the multiwall pipette.
Shake the plate with the plate shaker at a speed of 10 x g for 10 s.
Incubate the plate for 1 h in the incubator.
Take out the 96-well plate from the incubator.
Read the plate in the microplate reader by measuring the absorbance of the cell viability reagent (excitation 540 nm, emission 590 nm).
